title: Disable Default Browser Interactions in UI
description: All default browser interaction inside ui should be disabled. e.g. the input of engagement is remembering inputs, etc.
summary: Added centralized uiFormControlBrowserDefaultProps (autocomplete off, spellcheck off, mobile autocorrect/capitalize off, password-manager ignore hints) applied to Input, Textarea, CommandInput, and Stepper. Extended installElementsSurfaceBrowserDefaultSuppression with a focusin capture listener that applies the same defaults to any focused form control. Tests cover static markup attrs and focus-time application. All 135 @semio-tech/ui-react tests pass.
